notes: The directory lists 215 people total. Beyond the 41 ladder faculty and 9 emeritus professors recorded here, it also lists ~27 'Affiliate'/'Associate of the Department' faculty whose primary appointment and research group is housed elsewhere (e.g. HKS, HBS — not recorded here to avoid duplicating their home department's entry), plus lecturers/preceptors, ~115 PhD students, postdocs, peer concentration counselors and administrative staff — not individually recorded (not independent PIs). This is a breadth pass; political-science faculty here mostly don't run a 'lab' in the wet/dry-lab sense — pi_email/lab_website are null because the directory page doesn't show them and most of these scholars work solo or with RAs rather than a named group with its own site.
